links.outcome: Rate of problematic and unsafe chatbot responses to patient-posed medical questions
links.effect: Problematic responses ranged from 21.6% (Claude) to 43.2% (Llama); unsafe responses ranged from 5% (Claude) to 13% (GPT-4o, Llama).
links.quote: The rate of problematic responses varies from 21.6% (Claude) to 43.2% (Llama), with unsafe responses varying from 5% (Claude) to 13% (GPT-4o, Llama).

links.outcome: Safety of consumer LLM chatbot medical advice that patients may over-rely on
links.effect: Unsafe advice rates of 5% to 13% across four public chatbots; qualitative results show potential for serious patient harm.
links.quote: This study suggests that millions of patients could be receiving unsafe medical advice from publicly available chatbots, and further work is needed to improve the clinical safety of these powerful tools.

screen.reason: Empirical red-teaming evaluation of four commercial LLMs answering patient medical questions, assessing safety and harm potential without testing a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
